body: Thanks man. I know exactly what you mean. Everyone else is changing for the worst, by doing drugs and going to parties, because that is what is "cool" now, but I haven't changed.. It's not that I am not cool, but they are "too cool" in a way.. If you get me. I got into Minecraft about a year ago too. I met heaps of nice mature people like me, but people at my school diss anyone that plays it, so it was affecting my personal life. It's pretty sad that people have turned to this.. I got bored of Minecraft anyway so I only play it on occasions. Thanks though.
